title: CaRE Compute-aware Remasking Evaluation Protocol for Masked Diffusion Language Models
description:
arXiv:2607.24763v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) are advancing rapidly, yet the evaluation standards needed to reliably interpret their progress have not kept pace.
